# API reference

Every public declaration of the standard library, with its signature and documentation. `eye doc` writes these pages from the `##` comments in the source, so they always match the code.

| Module | |
|---|---|
| [Prelude](./std/prelude) | What every module sees without importing it: `Option`, `Result`, and the types that runs of jobs and calls to other services give back. |
| [Built-in types](./std/types) | Numbers, text, time, sizes and collections |
| [Built-in functions](./std/builtins) | Output, tests, time, collections, strings and numbers |
| [runtime.store](./runtime/store) | The in-memory store: everything a running program keeps, as one immutable value. |
| [ai](./std/ai) | Typed calls to language models. |
| [approvals](./std/approvals) | Approvals that reach people. |
| [fs](./std/fs) | Files and directories on the machine the program runs on. |
| [http](./std/http) | Requests to any URL, for services that have no contract, such as web pages. |
| [process](./std/process) | Running other programs. |
| [random](./std/random) | Random numbers and choices. |
